name: Sweet Devil ~Negaigoto, Kanaemasuu~
original_name: sweetでびる ～願いゴト、叶えますぅ～
source:
Main character is a shy introvert with his life passing by uneventfully. One day he finds an old book in the library that triggers his meeting with a devil girl. The girl is ready to fulfill any wish, but says that protagonist only has 10 days to live, and it can't be changed. Protagonist does not want to die, but if it's inevitable, he desires to have as much sex with cute girls over these 10 days as possible.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-february-2003-routes.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公性格内向而害羞，生活也一直平淡无奇。一天，他在图书馆里发现一本古书，由此遇见了一名恶魔少女。少女愿意实现他的任何愿望，却也告诉他，他只剩下10天可活，而且这个结局无法改变。主人公并不想死，可既然无法逃避，他希望在最后的10天里，尽可能与更多可爱女孩发生性关系。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-february-2003-routes.html]vndbreview[/url]]
